achievements.name: Rogueport Bound
achievements.detail: Read Princess Peach's letter at home and sail the ship that carries Mario to Rogueport.

achievements.name: Goombella Joins
achievements.detail: Help Goombella out of a scrape in Rogueport and take her into the party.

achievements.name: Hooktail Down
achievements.detail: Defeat the dragon Hooktail and leave her castle with that chapter's Crystal Star.

achievements.name: Glitz Champion
achievements.detail: Fight up the ranks and win the championship of Glitzville's Glitz Pit.

achievements.name: Excess Express
achievements.detail: Stay aboard the Excess Express until its journey reaches the last stop.

achievements.name: Seven Crystal Stars
achievements.detail: Collect all seven Crystal Stars marked on the magical map.

achievements.name: Open the Door
achievements.detail: Place all seven Crystal Stars in the pedestal and open the Thousand-Year Door.

achievements.name: Pit of 100 Trials
achievements.detail: Clear every floor of the Pit of 100 Trials beneath Rogueport.

achievements.name: Full Party
achievements.detail: Recruit every partner, including Ms. Mowz from her Trouble Center request.

achievements.name: Partner Rank Up
achievements.detail: Give Merlon three Shine Sprites and raise one partner to a higher rank.

achievements.name: Trouble Center
achievements.detail: Complete a request posted at Rogueport's Trouble Center.

achievements.name: Beyond the Door
achievements.detail: See the final chapter through on the other side of the Thousand-Year Door.
